answer: The strongest single control I know for this is rate-limited submission with exponential backoff, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 379 fakes spends 5306 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The velvet sits in the mechanism itself, the jade sits in the price of faking it, and the ferrous sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
